title: check-breaking-changes.ps1 Configuration
description: Configuration file for API compatibility checking script

Configuration.description: Build configuration to use for compatibility checking

BaselineTag.description: Git tag to use as baseline. If empty, uses last release-* tag

OutputPath.description: Directory to write compatibility reports. Default: Azure Pipelines staging or local ./api-compat

ThrottleLimit.description: Maximum concurrent threads for parallel processing. 0 = NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS
